Definition: Reajah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Three men share this name. Reaiah son of Shobal stands in Judah's line, a Reubenite Reaiah stands in the line of Reuben, and the children of Reaiah are counted among the Nethinim who came back from exile with Zerubbabel.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that God keeps the names of men the world forgets, and the lists themselves are proof that He counts His people one by one.
